WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "DAY_ID" IS NULL) AS null_0,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "MONTH_ID" IS NULL) AS null_1,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "YEAR_ID" IS NULL) AS null_2,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "DAY_NAME" IS NULL) AS null_3
  FROM "staging"."DIM_DATE"
)
SELECT 'row_count' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN n > 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       n AS count
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'not_null:DAY_ID' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN null_0 = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       null_0 AS count
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'not_null:MONTH_ID' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN null_1 = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       null_1 AS count
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'not_null:YEAR_ID' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN null_2 = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       null_2 AS count
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'not_null:DAY_NAME' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN null_3 = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       null_3 AS count
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'unique:DAY_ID' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       COUNT(*) AS count
FROM (
  SELECT "DAY_ID"
  FROM "staging"."DIM_DATE"
  GROUP BY "DAY_ID"
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS dupes

tableSpecs.selectSql:
WITH "base_fact_revenue" AS (
  SELECT
    "fact"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
    "fact"."SKU_ID" AS "SKU_ID",
    COALESCE("fact"."REVENUE", 0) AS "REVENUE"
  FROM "master"."FACT_REVENUE" AS "fact"
)
SELECT
  "dim_product"."CATEGORY_ID",
  COALESCE("dim_product"."CATEGORY_NAME", 'UNKNOWN'),
  "dim_product"."BRAND",
  SUM("fact_revenue"."REVENUE") AS "REVENUE"
FROM "base_fact_revenue" AS "fact_revenue"
JOIN "BY_CATEGORY"."DIM_PRODUCT_SKU_ID" AS "dim_product" ON "fact_revenue"."SKU_ID" = "dim_product"."SKU_ID"
GROUP BY
  "dim_product"."CATEGORY_ID",
  COALESCE("dim_product"."CATEGORY_NAME", 'UNKNOWN'),
  "dim_product"."BRAND"
